theorems.name: Submission.dgid_orthogonal_cylinder_isOpen
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ∃ v : Euclid n, ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) → IsOpen {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
